title: [PowerRename] "Aa" and "Aa Aa" text formatting options produce identical results

comment.body: These controls are Title case and Capitalize Each Word, not sentence case. They can both produce `Hello World.txt` from `hello world.txt`. An example such as `hello and the world.txt` distinguishes them: title case keeps the interior small words lower-case, while Capitalize Each Word capitalizes them. If that distinction fails on your build, please share the exact input and both previews; sentence-case conversion would be a separate feature.
